name: 11 Nimmt
summary: Shedding card game where you must play within 10 of a discard pile or take the pile, collecting bulls to play runs.
rules_text: Each player is dealt 10 numbered cards sorted ascending, rest forms a draw deck. One card starts the first discard pile. On your turn you must either play one card onto any pile or take an entire pile into your hand. A play must be higher than the pile top, with circular distance at most 10 (e.g., after 98, 1-8 are within 10). If you cannot play, you must take a pile. When a pile is taken, two new cards from the draw deck start two new piles, so pile count grows. Taking a pile of 3+ cards earns a bull card. A bull allows you to play a whole run of eligible cards onto one pile in one turn; two bulls allow runs on two piles, etc. If bull supply is empty you steal from the player with most bulls. A round ends when a player empties hand; others score penalty ox-heads from remaining cards. Play as many rounds as players; lowest total penalty wins.
rating_reason: Classic hand management stack avoidance, turn-based arithmetic ranking.
